raw_text: India has stepped up vigil along the Line of Actual Control in eastern Ladakh after detecting fresh Chinese military activity near the Galwan Valley. Defence sources confirmed that additional troops and armoured vehicles have been positioned at forward locations. The Indian Air Force has also increased surveillance sorties using Heron UAVs over the region. The buildup on both sides coincides with the approaching anniversary of the June 15, 2020 clash that killed 20 Indian soldiers.
